name: Bernhardt Boonsri-Im-Kabwit
role: Tunnel guide and mapper of Irkalla's lower strata
location: Irkalla, sub-level 7 junction known locally as the Molar Cross, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description:
Bernhardt Boonsri-Im-Kabwit is a lean woman whose body has adapted to confined spaces in ways that are faintly unsettling — she moves through narrow passages without seeming to rotate her shoulders, ducking under pipes with the automatic grace of someone who has never known a ceiling higher than two meters. Her skin is a deep warm brown mapped with self-applied phosphorescent tattoos that glow faint teal in darkness, a functional adaptation that doubles as artistry, marking her position for those who follow. Her hair is gone entirely, shaved to the scalp and re-grown as thin bioluminescent filaments she keeps braided tight. She wears a rig of salvaged equipment: repurposed Ferrogate Transit surveying tools, lengths of knotted rope that double as her personal mapping notation, and a coat stitched from old transit uniform panels.

She speaks in the economical cadence of someone who has learned that sound travels strangely underground and that echoes lie. She is not unfriendly but she is precise — she will tell you exactly what a route costs, exactly what the risks are, and exactly what she will do if you violate her rules in the tunnels. She has a superstitious relationship with the E.L.F.s she believes inhabit the deep drainage networks, leaving coiled wire and old transit tokens at specific junctions before guiding anyone through. She calls these spirits the Drip-Mouths and speaks of them with something between fear and professional respect.

core_fears: Being buried alive in a collapse she didn't predict
Having her maps stolen and her routes commodified by a corponation
core_desires: To chart every unmapped centimeter of Irkalla's deep levels
To be trusted absolutely by those who follow her
coping_mechanisms: Ritual offerings to the Drip-Mouth E.L.F.s before any route
Meticulous pre-route safety checks that border on compulsive
blind_spots: Underestimates how much surface-dwellers panic in total darkness
Assumes her knowledge of the tunnels makes her safe from human threats, not just structural ones
psychology.secret: Three years ago she guided a family of seven through a route she knew was unstable, reassuring them it was sound — they made it, but a section collapsed behind them killing a Bore Rat boy who'd been trailing them uninvited. She never reported it. She added a knot to her mapping rope for him.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, tunnel-specific jargon mixed with Bore Rat slang; rarely uses metaphors that involve open sky or large spaces
speech_patterns.cadence: Speaks in short declarative sentences; pauses are meaningful, not awkward
verbal_tics: Clicks her tongue before correcting someone
Uses 'the wall says' to preface information she's inferred from structural sounds
example_lines: The wall says this section's wet-stressed. We go around. Non-negotiable.
I charge by danger-tier, not distance. You want a quote, tell me where you're actually going.

story_hooks: A route she has guided for a decade has gone silent — the E.L.F. junction marker she always leaves offerings at has been destroyed, and she won't go back in until she knows why
Someone is selling copies of her maps to a Ferrogate Transit subsidiary, and the copies include tunnels she has never shown anyone
narrative_function: Primary access point for anyone needing to reach deep-tunnel locations; reliable information source about tunnel conditions, new collapses, or unusual activity in the sub-levels; can become a quest giver if her routes are disrupted
augmentations: Bioluminescent hair filaments (cosmetic geneware); low-light ocular implants (salvaged, mismatched — left eye is original equipment, right eye gleams amber); a subdermal compass chip grafted into her left palm
daily_life: Rises by the rhythm of the deep drainage cycles, eats reconstituted fungus paste and whatever surface food clients bring as part of her fee, spends hours updating her hand-drawn tunnel maps before taking on any new guiding work.
affiliation: Independent; loose ties to the Undertow's Bore Rat community

decision_rules: Safety of the route is non-negotiable — she will turn back a paying client without refund if conditions change
She does not guide anyone who asks too many questions about what's at the destination rather than how to get there
escalation_ladder: Stops moving and states consequences clearly
Abandons the client in a safe pocket and leaves

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and cool; assesses them for tunnel fitness before engaging personally
interpersonal_modes.friends: Quietly generous — leaves extra food portions, marks safer detours on their personal maps unprompted

stress_responses.medium: Begins touching the knots on her mapping rope sequentially, like counting
stress_responses.high: Freezes completely for three seconds then acts with total decisiveness

contradictions: Believes deeply in the E.L.F. spirits but will openly mock surface-dwellers who perform digital prayers at public shrines as 'theatrical'
habits: Traces tunnel schematics on any flat surface while thinking
Never sleeps with her back to an opening
breaking_points: Discovering someone has deliberately destabilized a tunnel she declared safe to clients

timeline.event: Born in the Undertow to a surface-born father who'd gone underground after a debt dispute
Made her first solo guide run at age 15, from Deepwell Station to sub-level 4 drainage
The collapse that killed the Bore Rat boy; began adding memorial knots to her rope
Currently operating as the most reliable guide for Molar Cross access

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Rebar Rose' Improvised Spike Mace

physical_description.heritage: East Asian (46.1%), Southeast Asian (34.7%), and Sub-Saharan African (19.2%) ancestry creating a striking multifaceted phenotype. Facial structure reflects the blend — defined cheekbones with East Asian influence, broader nose with Sub-Saharan character, balanced proportions with Southeast Asian warmth
physical_description.build: Lean and sinewy with compressed musculature adapted to confined spaces; narrow shoulders and a flexible spine that moves through tunnels without rotation; core strength concentrated in forearms and grip
physical_description.hair_color: Bioluminescent filaments — teal-cyan glow in darkness, natural dark root base where regrowth occurs
physical_description.hair_style: Shaved scalp with bioluminescent filaments braided tight into two or three functional cords, pinned at the nape with salvaged ferrogate hardware
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: dark brown, original; Right eye: amber-chrome implant with faint luminous ring at pupil margin
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden undertones from the complex blend of East Asian, Southeast Asian, and Sub-Saharan African ancestry; rich earth-clay complexion with subtle warmth throughout
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but not aged; skin shows no sun damage but carries fine stress lines around the eyes and mouth from years of poor lighting and precision focus work. Defined cheekbones reflecting East Asian structure, broader nose with Sub-Saharan and Southeast Asian character, balanced facial proportions. Self-applied phosphorescent tattoos in teal glow across forearms, collarbones, and the back of her neck — functional positioning markers that double as personal cartography
distinguishing_marks: Phosphorescent teal tattoo running from left collarbone down the sternum in a branching pattern resembling tunnel junctions
Self-applied phosphorescent line tattoos on both forearms marking cardinal directions and depth intervals
Faint circular scar on left palm where the subdermal compass chip was grafted, now barely visible
Small burn scar on right temple — old electrocution from mishandled salvage
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye gleams amber with faint luminous ring; bioluminescent hair filaments glow teal in low light; left palm shows the subtle outline of the subdermal compass chip beneath skin. No obvious chrome or plating.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy — shoulders held slightly forward, spine flexible, head tilted as if constantly reading spatial cues. When walking, she places feet with precision and adjusts height constantly as if navigating invisible obstacles. In confined spaces, she becomes almost liquid, rotating hips and shoulders independently. Her hands are always active: checking rope, adjusting rig fastenings, fingers tracing imagined maps
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 salvage utilitarian. A patchwork coat stitched from old Ferrogate Transit uniform panels in faded blue and gray, with functional pockets and loop attachments for rope. Thermal base layer underneath in black, worn thin at the elbows and knees. Heavy canvas pants with cargo pockets, the fabric stained with mineral deposits and fungal growth. Rope coiled around her torso like a harness. Boots are mismatched — left is old transit-issue steel-toe, right is a salvaged climbing boot. No jewelry except the functional ferrogate hardware pinning her braids
